headline: A wedding in {city} that the whole city is expected to notice — {good} is dear while it lasts, and nobody is haggling.
A death in the household that governs {city}. Black cloth, funeral wine, and a great deal of it: {good} will fetch what it is asked for until the mourning is done.
The pilgrim season has come to {city} early and heavy. {good} goes at whatever the innkeepers will pay, which is more than usual.
A harvest at {city} better than anyone had room for. {good} is cheap, and will stay cheap until the surplus is drunk or spoiled.
A fleet has come into {city} carrying nothing but {good}, and the quays cannot absorb it. The price is on the floor and everyone knows why.
The guild at {city} has closed {good} to foreign houses — not taxed, not restricted, closed. Nothing moves in or out of that trade here until they say otherwise.
A customs quarrel at {city} nobody will explain in writing. {good} is impounded on the quay and the house's factor has been advised, politely, to trade something else.
Word at {city} of an army on the move, and nobody has yet said whose. Every price in the city has come off its hinges at once.
Sickness reported in {city}, or reported to have been reported. The quays are half-manned, buyers have gone inland, and everything is going cheap to whoever is still willing to stand there.
